calls.thesis: Lisa Su's Taipei comments (expanding CPU/GPU production, wafer capacity for several years of demand) add another 'brick' to his bullish thesis house; market wants constant confirmation and got it.
calls.base: Server CPU revenue expected to grow >70% in 2027; total data center revenue expected to more than double.
calls.bull: Server CPU TAM grew from $60B (Nov 2025) to $220B; MI450/Halos ramp with capacity build.
calls.bear: None stated in this video beyond general long-dated-guidance caution.

calls.thesis: $8.2B all-stock acquisition of World Labs (AI model/research lab) is a smart talent grab giving AMD deeper insight into evolving AI workloads and its tech roadmap. All-stock is the right call (<1% of market cap). Trusts Lisa Su's judgment; expects the deal to look smart in hindsight. Mild worry AMD is spreading itself thin (software stack, Helios ramp, now AI models).
